figures.shows: The Streaming panel's cell map of the Open World island with the cells around the player loaded
figures.caption: The cell map draws each cell of a layer as a square, and the loaded squares cluster around the player while the rest of the island stays unloaded.
figures.alt: The editor's Streaming panel with a grid of squares for the island's cells. The squares near a marker for the player are orange, as loaded, and the others are dark gray, as unloaded. A blue circle around the marker shows how far the player reaches.

figures.shows: The gap between neighbouring float values from 1 km to 100 km on log axes, with the supported extent marked
figures.caption: The gap stays flat inside each range of powers of two and doubles at each power, and the dashed line marks the supported extent of a world.
figures.alt: A line chart on logarithmic axes. A blue stepped line rises from left to right and doubles at each power of two. A dashed red vertical line marks the supported extent, and three black dots mark the gaps at 1, 20 and 100 kilometres.
